name: The Vault
subtitle: Abundance Bracelet · Pyrite
promise: Solid pyrite. Heavy, brassy and unbothered.
body: Eight-millimetre pyrite with its natural pitted, brassy surface, strung without any other metal. Fool's gold, traditionally worn for willpower, prosperity and a thicker skin. Real stock from the studio, and once these are gone we will not restring them.
seoDescription: Pyrite bracelet, traditionally worn for prosperity and willpower. Last pieces, hand-strung in Dubai, next-day delivery across the UAE.
